tools.name: JSON Formatter & Prettifier
tools.short_description: Format, prettify, sort keys, and minify JSON payloads client-side.
tools.long_description: High-performance JSON formatter supporting custom indentation (2 or 4 spaces), key alphabetical sorting, and payload minification. Operates strictly in-memory client-side with safe length limits.

tools.name: JSON Validator & Linter
tools.short_description: Validate RFC 8259 JSON syntax with precise line and column error reporting.
tools.long_description: Strict RFC 8259 syntax checker that locates missing commas, unescaped characters, and malformed object pairs with exact line/column indicators and error highlighting.

tools.name: JSON ↔ CSV Converter
tools.short_description: Bidirectional conversion between tabular JSON array objects and CSV data.
tools.long_description: Convert complex tabular JSON records into CSV format with auto-detected headers, or parse CSV records into structured JSON arrays. Supports custom delimiters and quote escaping.

tools.name: YAML ↔ JSON Converter
tools.short_description: Translate configuration files between YAML and JSON syntax with validation.
tools.long_description: Bidirectional YAML and JSON converter designed for Kubernetes manifests, Docker Compose files, and cloud configuration payloads. Safe PyYAML parsing without arbitrary code execution.

tools.name: XML Formatter & Beautifier
tools.short_description: Format, indent, and minify XML documents with XXE security defense.
tools.long_description: Beautify or minify raw XML payloads with configurable indentation. Features built-in XXE (XML External Entity) and entity expansion defense to protect against entity injection attacks.

tools.name: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
tools.short_description: Encode and decode standard or URL-safe Base64 strings with automatic padding.
tools.long_description: Encodes UTF-8 strings into RFC 4648 standard Base64 or URL-safe Base64, and decodes incoming strings with automatic padding reconstruction and UTF-8 error tolerance.

tools.name: JWT Token Claims Decoder
tools.short_description: Decode JSON Web Tokens into Header and Payload with human-readable timestamps.
tools.long_description: Inspect JWT headers, algorithms, expiry (exp), issued-at (iat), and custom claims client-side. Explicitly notes non-cryptographic verification for security clarity.

tools.name: UUID / GUID Batch Generator
tools.short_description: Bulk generate cryptographically secure UUID v4 and timestamp-based UUID v1.
tools.long_description: Generate up to 100 RFC 4122 compliant UUIDs with options for uppercase formatting, hyphens removal, and curly brace wrapping. Fast and deterministic.

tools.name: Regular Expression Tester
tools.short_description: Test regex patterns, inspect named capture groups, and preview substitutions.
tools.long_description: Evaluate Python-compatible regular expressions in real-time. Includes capture group inspection, flag toggles (ignore case, multiline, dotall), and ReDoS character limit protections.

tools.name: Cron Expression Builder & Explainer
tools.short_description: Construct standard 5-part cron schedules and decode expressions into English.
tools.long_description: Interactive visual cron builder supporting presets (hourly, daily, weekly) and field breakdowns for minutes, hours, days, months, and weekdays with instant English schedule translation.

tools.name: Unix Timestamp Converter
tools.short_description: Convert epoch seconds and milliseconds to UTC, ISO 8601, and relative times.
tools.long_description: Translates epoch seconds or milliseconds to ISO 8601, RFC 2822, UTC, and local timezone formats with human-readable relative time calculations (e.g. '3 hours ago').

tools.name: URL Encoder, Decoder & Inspector
tools.short_description: Percent-encode query parameters and deconstruct URLs into structural parts.
tools.long_description: Encode or decode query string parameters with support for form-encoded plus spaces. Deconstructs URLs into scheme, hostname, port, path, query dictionary, and fragment components.

tools.name: Text Diff Checker
tools.short_description: Compare code and text side-by-side with additions, deletions, and similarity.
tools.long_description: Computes unified and side-by-side diffs using Python standard difflib. Calculates character similarity percentages, additions counts, deletions counts, and configurable context lines.

tools.name: Hash & HMAC Calculator
tools.short_description: Compute SHA-256, SHA-512, MD5 hashes, HMAC signatures, and constant-time check.
tools.long_description: Calculates multi-algorithm cryptographic digests client-side. Includes secret-keyed HMAC generation and constant-time string comparison to prevent timing attack vulnerabilities.

tools.name: Markdown Previewer & Outline Inspector
tools.short_description: Live Markdown rendering, table-of-contents extraction, and XSS safety check.
tools.long_description: Real-time rendering of Markdown syntax with automated heading outline extraction, word count metrics, reading time estimations, and detection of potentially unsafe HTML script tags.

tools.name: HTML Minifier & Optimizer
tools.short_description: Minify HTML markup, strip comments, and collapse inter-tag whitespace.
tools.long_description: Compresses HTML documents, strips non-conditional comments, and eliminates unnecessary whitespace while strictly preserving literal code, pre, script, and textarea tag contents.

tools.name: CSS Minifier & Optimizer
tools.short_description: Compress CSS stylesheets, remove comments, and eliminate whitespace.
tools.long_description: Minifies CSS stylesheets, strips block comments, normalizes declaration delimiters, removes redundant trailing semicolons, and calculates byte savings and compression percentages.

tools.name: Color Converter & WCAG Contrast Inspector
tools.short_description: Convert HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK, and verify WCAG AA accessibility compliance.
tools.long_description: Converts color codes bidirectionally between HEX, RGB, HSL, and CMYK formats. Computes exact relative luminance and tests WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA contrast ratios against white and black canvases.

tools.name: Text Case Converter
tools.short_description: Convert strings across camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, and kebab-case.
tools.long_description: Intelligent tokenizer that parses camelCase, snake_case, spaces, and punctuation, transforming identifiers into 12 standard programming cases including CONSTANT_CASE and dot.case.

tools.name: QR Code Generator
tools.short_description: Generate vector SVG and PNG QR codes with configurable error correction.
tools.long_description: Generates QR codes for URLs, plain text, and Wi-Fi networks. Exports high-resolution PNG images or scalable vector SVG assets with selectable error correction levels (L, M, Q, H).

tools.name: API Sentinel Route Simulator
tools.short_description: Standalone in-memory API route simulator, header inspector, and response mocker.
tools.long_description: Simulate REST API endpoints with custom JSON payloads, headers, latency delays, and error codes without provisioning a live backend. Completely in-memory and ephemeral.

tools.name: Data Forge Tabular Generator
tools.short_description: Generate synthetic tabular datasets and mock relational databases.
tools.long_description: Deterministic and randomized generation of synthetic datasets for testing database queries, data pipelines, and UI tables. Exports directly to CSV, JSON, and SQL INSERT scripts.

tools.name: Diagram Studio Architecture Canvas
tools.short_description: Interactive Mermaid.js architecture diagrams and system visualizer.
tools.long_description: Renders system architecture diagrams, sequence flows, and entity relationship diagrams directly from Mermaid syntax with zero backend compilation. Runs statically in the browser.

tools.name: DeveloperOS Quick Hub Chrome Extension
tools.short_description: Offline JWT, Base64, and UUID browser extension with zero permissions.
tools.long_description: Instant offline browser extension for developers. Decodes JWTs, computes Base64 strings, and generates UUIDs without internet access or permissions. Complies with Chrome Manifest V3.

tools.name: OpenGraph & Meta Tag Generator
tools.short_description: Generate social sharing cards and SEO meta tags with real-time preview.
tools.long_description: Interactive generator for OpenGraph, Twitter Cards, and standard SEO meta tags. Provides real-time rendering of social sharing previews on desktop and mobile platforms.

tools.name: DeveloperOS QuickTools Chrome Extension
tools.short_description: Privacy-first Manifest V3 developer extension with 10 utilities and tool launcher.
tools.long_description: Lightweight, privacy-conscious Chrome Manifest V3 developer extension featuring 10 offline utilities: JSON Formatter, JWT Decoder, Base64 Tool, UUID Generator, SHA Hash Generator, Unix Timestamp Converter, Color Picker, QR Code Generator, Text Toolkit, and Searchable Tool Launcher.
